::: {#def-f-dist}
#### F-distribution

Let $U$ have the $\chi^2_{k_1}$ distribution,
let $V$ have the $\chi^2_{k_2}$ distribution,
and let $U$ and $V$ be independent.
The distribution of

$$\frac{U / k_1}{V / k_2}$$

is the **F-distribution with $k_1$ and $k_2$ degrees of freedom**,
written $F_{k_1, k_2}$.
:::
